entries.title: Luke 22:1
segments: The Feast of the Unleavened Bread, known as the Passover, was near.

entries.title: Luke 22:2
segments: The Chief Priest and the Teachers of the Law were looking for an opportunity of destroying Jesus, for they were afraid of the people.

entries.title: Luke 22:3
segments: Now Satan took possession of Judas, who was known as Iscariot, and who belonged to the Twelve;

entries.title: Luke 22:4
segments: And he went and discussed with the Chief Priests and Officers in charge at the Temple the best way of betraying Jesus to them.

entries.title: Luke 22:5
segments: They were glad of this, and agreed to pay him.

entries.title: Luke 22:6
segments: So Judas assented, and looked for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them, in the absence of a crowd.

entries.title: Luke 22:7
segments: When the day of the Festival of the Unleavened Bread came, on which the Passover lambs had to be killed,

entries.title: Luke 22:8
segments: Jesus sent forward Peter and John, saying to them: "Go and make preparations for our eating the Passover."

entries.title: Luke 22:9
segments: "Where do you wish us to make preparations?" they asked.

entries.title: Luke 22:10
segments: "Listen," he answered, when you have got into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you; follow him into whatever house he enters;

entries.title: Luke 22:11
segments: And you shall say to the owner of the house 'The Teacher says to you--Where is the room where I am to eat the Passover with my disciples?'

entries.title: Luke 22:12
segments: The man will show you a large upstairs room, set out; there make preparations."

entries.title: Luke 22:13
segments: So Peter and John went on, and found everything just as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

entries.title: Luke 22:14
segments: When the time came, Jesus took his place at table, and the Apostles with him.

entries.title: Luke 22:15
segments: "I have most earnestly wished," he said, "to eat this Passover with you before I suffer.

entries.title: Luke 22:16
segments: For I tell you that I shall not eat it again, until it has had its fulfillment in the Kingdom of God."

entries.title: Luke 22:17
segments: Then, on receiving a cup, after saying the thanksgiving, he said:

entries.title: Luke 22:18
segments: "Take this and share it among you. For I tell you that I shall not, after to-day, drink of the juice of the grape, till the Kingdom of God has come."

entries.title: Luke 22:19
segments: Then Jesus took some bread, and, after saying the thanksgiving, broke it and gave to them, with the words: "This is my body, [which is now to be given on your behalf. Do this in memory of me."

entries.title: Luke 22:20
segments: And in the same way with the cup, after supper, saying: "This cup is the New Covenant made by my blood which is being poured out on your behalf.]

entries.title: Luke 22:21
segments: Yet see! the hand of the man that is betraying me is beside me upon the table!

entries.title: Luke 22:22
segments: True, the Son of Man is passing, by the way ordained for him, yet alas for that man by whom he is being betrayed!"

entries.title: Luke 22:23
segments: Then they began questioning one another which of them it could be that was going to do this.

entries.title: Luke 22:24
segments: And a dispute arose among them as to which of them was to be regarded as the greatest.

entries.title: Luke 22:25
segments: Jesus, however, said: "The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their oppressors are styled 'Benefactors.'

entries.title: Luke 22:26
segments: But with you it must not be so. No, let the greatest among you become like the youngest, and him who leads like him who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:27
segments: Which is the greater--the master at the table or his servant? Is not it the master at the table? Yet I myself am among you as one who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:28
segments: You are the men who have stood by me in my trials;

entries.title: Luke 22:29
segments: And, just as my Father has assigned me a Kingdom, I assign you places,

entries.title: Luke 22:30
segments: So that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom, and be seated upon twelve thrones as judges of the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Luke 22:31
segments: Simon! Simon! listen. Satan demanded leave to sift you all like wheat,

entries.title: Luke 22:32
segments: But I prayed for you, Simon, that your faith should not fail. And you, when you have returned to me, are to strengthen your Brothers."

entries.title: Luke 22:33
segments: "Master," said Peter, "with you I am ready to go both to prison and to death."

entries.title: Luke 22:34
segments: "I tell you, Peter," replied Jesus, "the cock will not crow to-day till you have disowned all knowledge of me three times."

entries.title: Luke 22:35
segments: Then he said to them all: "When I sent you out as my Messengers, without either purse, or bag, or sandals, were you in need of anything?" "No; nothing," they answered.

entries.title: Luke 22:36
segments: "Now, however," he said, "he who has a purse must take it and his bag as well; and he who has not must sell his cloak and buy a sword.

entries.title: Luke 22:37
segments: For, I tell you, that passage of Scripture must be fulfilled in me, which says--'He was counted among the godless'; indeed all that refers to me is finding its fulfillment."

entries.title: Luke 22:38
segments: "Master," they exclaimed, "look, here are two swords!" "Enough!" said Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 22:39
segments: Jesus then went out, and made his way as usual to the Mount of Olives, followed by his disciples.

entries.title: Luke 22:40
segments: And, when he reached the spot, he said to them: "Pray that you may not fall into temptation."

entries.title: Luke 22:41
segments: Then he withdrew about a stone's throw, and knelt down and began to pray.

entries.title: Luke 22:42
segments: "Father," he said, "if it is thy pleasure, spare me this cup; only, not my will but thine be done."

entries.title: Luke 22:43
segments: [Presently there appeared to him an angel from Heaven, who strengthened him.

entries.title: Luke 22:44
segments: And, as his anguish became intense, he prayed still more earnestly, while his sweat was like great drops of blood falling on the ground.]

entries.title: Luke 22:45
segments: Then he rose from praying, and came to the disciples and found them sleeping for sorrow.

entries.title: Luke 22:46
segments: "Why are you asleep?" he asked them. "Rise and pray, that you may not fall into temptation."

entries.title: Luke 22:47
segments: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared in sight, led by the man called Judas, who was one of the Twelve. Judas approached Jesus, to kiss him;

entries.title: Luke 22:48
segments: On which Jesus said to him: "Judas, is it by a kiss that you betray the Son of Man?"

entries.title: Luke 22:49
segments: But when those who were round Jesus saw what was going to happen, they exclaimed: "Master, shall we use our swords?"

entries.title: Luke 22:50
segments: And one of them struck the High Priest's servant and cut off his right ear;

entries.title: Luke 22:51
segments: On which Jesus said: "Let me at least do this"; and, touching his ear, he healed the wound.

entries.title: Luke 22:52
segments: Then, turning to the Chief Priests and Officers in charge at the Temple and Councillors, who had come for him, he said: "Have you come out, as if after a robber, with swords and clubs?

entries.title: Luke 22:53
segments: When I was with you day after day in the Temple Courts, you did not lay hands on me; but now your time has come, and the power of Darkness."

entries.title: Luke 22:54
segments: Those who had taken Jesus prisoner took him away into the house of the High Priest. Peter followed at a distance.

entries.title: Luke 22:55
segments: But, when they had lit a fire in the center of the court-yard and had all sat down there, Peter seated himself in the middle of them.

entries.title: Luke 22:56
segments: Presently a maidservant saw him sitting near the blaze of the fire. Fixing her eyes on him, she said: "Why, this man was one of his companions!"

entries.title: Luke 22:57
segments: But Peter denied it. "I do not know him," he replied.

entries.title: Luke 22:58
segments: A little while afterwards some one else--a man--saw him and said: "Why, you are one of them!" "No," Peter said, "I am not."

entries.title: Luke 22:59
segments: About an hour later another man declared positively: "This man also was certainly with him. Why, he is a Galilean!"

entries.title: Luke 22:60
segments: But Peter said: "I do not know what you are speaking about." Instantly, while he was still speaking, a cock crowed.

entries.title: Luke 22:61
segments: And the Master turned and looked at Peter; and Peter remembered the words that the Master had said to him--"Before a cock has crowed to-day, you will disown me three times";

entries.title: Luke 22:62
segments: And he went outside and wept bitterly.

entries.title: Luke 22:63
segments: The men that held Jesus kept making sport of him and beating him.

entries.title: Luke 22:64
segments: They blindfolded him and then questioned him. "Now play the Prophet," they said; "who was it that struck you?"

entries.title: Luke 22:65
segments: And they heaped many other insults on him.

entries.title: Luke 22:66
segments: At daybreak the National Council met--both the Chief Priests and the Teachers of the Law--and took Jesus before their High Council.

entries.title: Luke 22:67
segments: "If you are the Christ," they said, "tell us so." "If I tell you," replied Jesus, "you will not believe me;

entries.title: Luke 22:68
segments: And, if I question you, you will not answer.

entries.title: Luke 22:69
segments: But from this hour 'the Son of Man will be seated on the right hand of God Almighty.'"

entries.title: Luke 22:70
segments: "Are you, then, the Son of God?" they all asked. "It is true," answered Jesus, "I am."

entries.title: Luke 22:71
segments: At this they exclaimed: "Why do we want any more evidence? We have heard it ourselves from his own lips!"
